name: SafetyBench
description: SafetyBench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the safety of large language models (LLMs) using 11,435 multiple choice questions across 7 categories of safety concerns. It supports both Chinese and English languages and aims to facilitate broad safety assessment and improvement of LLMs.
reputation: Widely used as a safety evaluation benchmark for Chinese and English LLMs, especially for multiple-choice safety assessment.
notes: Includes both Chinese and English data; covers 7 safety concern categories; leaderboard and submission platform available.
